result.summary: The page looks generally well-designed and functional, with only minor content issues detected. No critical layout or functionality problems found.

issues.description: Typo in the search field placeholder text: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' should read 'Restaurants'.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, truncating the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...'). This may be intentional horizontal scrolling, but the truncation gives an incomplete appearance.
